response.sql: WITH rc AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inventory i JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), avgc AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM rc) SELECT SUM(rc.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(rc.cnt - avgc.a) AS avg_excess FROM rc CROSS JOIN avgc WHERE rc.cnt > avgc.a

assumptions.assumption: The count per rating is the number of inventory rows (copies) joined to films, not distinct films; ratings with no inventory do not appear, so the across-rating average is over ratings present in the join.
The across-rating average is the unweighted mean of the per-rating counts, computed over all ratings before filtering.
